title: Meet K9 Officer Oskar!
description:
This Dog Appreciation Month, we introduce you to Sgt. Ted Laurendeau and his K9 partner, Oskar! They are a team built on trust. From searches to critical calls, Oskar is always ready to work by his side. 

Their partnership is a reminder of the dedication behind every K9 team in the City of San Diego. Thank you, both, for protecting our city! 

#SanDiego #K9 #SDPD #dog
